AssumptionNames: /\ Cardinality(Node) = Cardinality(SlushLoopProcess) /\ Cardinality(Node) = Cardinality(SlushQueryProcess) /\ SlushIterationCount \in Nat /\ SampleSetSize \in Nat /\ PickFlipThreshold \in Nat
IfThenElse: IF ~Terminate THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "WaitForQueryMessageOrTermination"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"] /\ UNCHANGED << pick, message, sampleSet, loopVariant >> (in QueryReplyLoop)

IF Terminate THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "QueryReplyLoop"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "RespondToQueryMessage"] /\ UNCHANGED << pick, message, sampleSet, loopVariant >> (in WaitForQueryMessageOrTermination)
IF Pick(self) = NoColor THEN msg.color ELSE Pick(self) (in RespondToQueryMessage)

IF loopVariant[self] < SlushIterationCount THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "QuerySampleSet"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "SlushLoopTermination"] /\ UNCHANGED << pick, message, sampleSet, loopVariant >> (in ExecuteSlushLoop)

IF redTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Red] ELSE /\ IF blueTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Blue] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick /\ message' = message \cup {msg \in message : /\ msg.type = QueryReplyMessageType /\ msg.src \in sampleSet[self] /\ msg.dst = self} /\ sampleSet' = [sampleSet EXCEPT ![self] = {}] /\ loopVariant' = [loopVariant EXCEPT ![self] = loopVariant[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "ExecuteSlushLoop"] (in TallyQueryReplies)
IF blueTally >= PickFlipThreshold THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![HostOf[self]] = Blue] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick (in TallyQueryReplies)

IF \E n \in Node : pick[n] = NoColor THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT !["ClientRequest"] = "AssignColorToNode"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT !["ClientRequest"] = "Done"] /\ UNCHANGED << pick, message, sampleSet, loopVariant >> (in ClientRequestLoop)
IF pick[node] = NoColor THEN /\ pick' = [pick EXCEPT ![node] = color] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ pick' = pick (in AssignColorToNode)

[type |-> QueryReplyMessageType, src |-> self, dst |-> msg.src, color |-> color]

DivisionNotes: Action operators (e.g., QueryReplyLoop, TallyQueryReplies, Next) were placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef because they contain primed variables or UNCHANGED expressions, which excludes them from the StatePredicate category.
Value definitions (e.g., Color, Message, vars, ProcSet) and set-valued helpers (e.g., PendingQueryMessage) were also placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef.
TemporalNesting is false as no temporal operators are nested within others (standard [][Next]_vars and <>Done patterns only).
